ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes, any cookie/consent/gdpr-named element inside a fixed/sticky/high-z overlay)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: remove main .facebook-feed (live Facebook posts rendered client-side as a desktop grid + a duplicate mobile carousel); the section heading "Stay connected on our socials" stays in scope
ledger.why: third-party runtime data, not authored page content: post text and images change between loads, so byte equality cannot hold; carried as a dynamic surface (dynamics disposition: embed/defer) rather than as static content
UI chrome injected by the source theme, no content bytes; donor kit has its own Back to Top module

visibleTextNormalized: Welcome to Fort Street High School Since 1849, Fortians have been encouraged to be the makers of their own destiny - faber est suae quisque fortunae. This motto underpins the values and expectations of the school. Why Choose Us? The Fort Street High School difference Our vision for student achievement Fort Street is proud to continue its co-educational traditions. We value the mix of young men and women learning together. We expect students to develop as model citizens and work towards developing individual and collaborative skills and attributes in each student. east Extensive range of student opportunities and activities At Fort Street High School, we offer a variety of programs in the classroom and across the school to help students build new skills, make friends and explore new interests. east Wellbeing at Fort Street is for all students A focus on wellbeing goes beyond the welfare needs of a few individual students and aims for all students to be healthy, happy, successful and productive individuals who are active and positive contributors to the school and society in which they live. east Principal's message It is my honour to serve as Principal of Fort Street High School, a school with a remarkable history and a proud tradition of nurturing some of Australia’s finest minds since its establishment in 1849. As the oldest government high school in Australia, Fort Street has long been a beacon of academic excellence, innovation, and social conscience. Situated on Gadigal and Wangal land in Petersham, our school community is a vibrant reflection of multicultural Australia. With approximately 920 students representing over 100 Sydney suburbs and speaking around 40 different languages, Fort Street is a harmonious and inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and fosters tolerance and acceptance. Read more from our Principal Fort Fest is on Friday 18 September, 3:15pm - 8:30pm. Fort Fest is an evening event for all the school and local community, with music, food, games and stalls. Run jointly by the SRC and P&C as a fundraiser, it is also a great way to meet and connect with other Fort Street families. Find out more School tours and open evenings School tours and open evenings are an opportunity for prospective students and parents to get a better understanding of Fort Street's values and educational philosophy. Dates and booking information Quick links Parent portals Stay connected through our parent portal apps. Use them to make a payment, for attendance matters or to book a parent-teacher interview. east Student and Parent Calendar (opens in new window) Information for parents and students about upcoming events, exams and excursions. east Forms Change of details, extended leave, and other school forms. east Instrumental Music Program (IMP) How to join, ensemble and fees. east Duke of Edinburgh The Duke of Edinburgh’s Award is open to students 14 years of age or older. Learn about how you can get involved. east Newsletters Discover the latest updates and exciting events happening at our school. Check out our newsletters to stay connected! east Ready to apply? Fort Street High School is an academically selective coeducational secondary school and does not have a local area intake. Entry is competitive and based on academic merit. There is a maximum enrolment of 150 students in each of Years 7-10. There are between 160 and 170 students in each of Years 11 and 12.
